Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps
     
  • Class
    Description
    EditorDocument
    The image editor's document model: a fixed-size canvas and an ordered stack of ImageLayers (index 0 is the bottom).
    FilterEngine
    The image editor's pixel filters, implemented with plain Java 2D (RescaleOp, ConvolveOp and per-pixel loops) - no third-party imaging library, no Java 3D.
    ImageEditor
    The image editor application: the ImageEditorPanel Swing UI presented as an integrated 3D desktop window (title bar plus minimize / maximize / close) via TitledSwingWindow.
    ImageEditorClient
    Standalone JFrame wrapper for the image editor panel, for running it outside the desktop (java org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imageeditor.ImageEditorClient).
    ImageEditorPanel
    The image editor's user interface, a compact GIMP-style workspace: a drawing toolbar on top, a layers panel on the right, a filters / undo bar along the bottom, and a scrollable canvas in the centre.
    ImageLayer
    One editable layer of an EditorDocument: a name, an RGBA image the tools paint into, a visibility flag and an opacity (0..1).
    ToolEngine
    The image editor's drawing primitives.
    ToolEngine.Tool
    The toolbar's drawing modes.
    UndoStack<T>
    A bounded undo / redo stack of immutable state snapshots.
